wordProblems.q: There are 12 birds on a tree. 5 birds fly away. How many birds are left on the tree?
Mason has 7 pencils. Mason finds 5 more pencils in a drawer. How many pencils does Mason have now?
Sophia has 8 balloons. 2 balloons pop. How many balloons does Sophia have left?
Ella has 10 books on her shelf. Her mum buys her 3 more books. How many books does Ella have now?
Ethan has 11 crayons. He loses 5 crayons at school. How many crayons does Ethan have left?
Chloe picks 13 oranges from a tree. Then Chloe picks 2 more oranges. How many oranges did Chloe pick in all?
There are 11 ducks in a pond. 9 ducks swim away. How many ducks are left in the pond?
Layla makes 12 cupcakes. Her friend brings 2 more cupcakes. How many cupcakes are there in all?
Ben has 15 toy cars. He gives 12 toy cars to his little brother. How many toy cars does Ben have left?
Omar finds 5 seashells on the beach in the morning and 4 seashells in the afternoon. How many seashells did Omar find in all?
Sophia has 10 flowers in her garden. She picks 2 flowers for her teacher. How many flowers are left in the garden?
Leo eats 4 grapes at lunch and 6 grapes after school. How many grapes did Leo eat in all?
Noah is reading a book with 11 pages. Noah reads 7 pages today. How many pages are left to read?
A baker makes 4 muffins in the morning and 4 muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins did the baker make in all?
There are 11 fish in a tank. The shop sells 10 fish. How many fish are left in the tank?
Sophia has 8 red beads and 7 blue beads. How many beads does Sophia have in all?
Leo collects 10 toy trains. He lends 2 trains to a friend. How many trains does Leo have left?
Ruby has 15 apples in a basket. Ruby eats 2 apples. How many apples are left in the basket?
Mason draws 4 stars on Monday and 5 stars on Tuesday. How many stars did Mason draw in all?
A monkey has 15 bananas. It eats 3 bananas. How many bananas does the monkey have left?
Lucas builds a tower with 4 blocks. Then he adds 11 more blocks on top. How many blocks are in the tower now?
Ava has 8 buttons in a box. She uses 6 buttons to sew a dress. How many buttons are left in the box?
Zoe buys 4 peaches at the market. Then Zoe buys 7 more peaches. How many peaches did Zoe buy in all?
There are 6 frogs sitting on a log. 3 frogs jump into the water. How many frogs are left on the log?
Chloe collects 11 smooth rocks at the river and 2 smooth rocks at the lake. How many smooth rocks did Chloe collect in all?
Sophia has 7 cherries in a bowl. She gives 2 cherries to her friend. How many cherries are left in the bowl?
2 red buses and 11 yellow buses are parked at the station. How many buses are parked at the station in all?
Emma has 15 pairs of socks in a drawer. Emma takes 1 pair out to wear this week. How many pairs of socks are left in the drawer?
Ben flies 12 kites in the park. His dad brings 3 more kites. How many kites are there now?
Lily has 15 candies in a jar. She shares 9 candies with her sister. How many candies are left in the jar?
